newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Higher European feeds start slow.
newsitem.headline: Higher European feeds start slow.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started slow this morning with sellers offering South American soymeal pellets as much as $10 up following last night's limit-up Chicago soymeal futures close, dealers said.
Most other products were offered at barely changed levels compared to yesterday midday. Bids were scarce and no trades were reported during the initial stages.

"The soaring soymeal prices, some $18 up from the start of the week, and a stronger dollar kept most buyers sidelined. The rise in Chicago is mainly seen as technical and dealers here prefer to wait of Friday's USDA crop report," one broker said.
